item.title: Elevated outage risk: Washington, MO
item.description: 13% chance of a new outage affecting 5% or more of customers, 8 pm to 2 am CST today (range 12%-13%). About 9 alerts a year per county; in 2025 about 1 in 5 was followed by an outage. Experimental research forecast, not from your utility or the National Weather Service.
